text:
maya_cs: Quick 15m welcome at 11:15 to align on HelioHealth activation — owners, success criteria, immediate risks. Can folks confirm availability?
jordan_pm: I can do 11:15. I'll own product acceptance criteria. @olivia_success can you lead enablement?
olivia_success: Yep — I'll run the API walkthrough + enablement. Tentative success criteria: 95% integration tests passing, sample traffic within SLA, first response <300ms. I'll capture feedback in a short survey after session.
sam_se: I'll own infra + sample payloads. Question: HelioHealth expects 12mo data retention — any compliance blockers we should flag now?
li_eng: No compliance blockers on our side, but private deployment + SSO will add ~2w for integration testing. If they need a faster pilot, recommend hosted route with PHI blackout.
maya_cs: Timeline proposal: smoke tests by EOD Fri (3 days), internal pilot Mon, full customer pilot in 14 days. Renewal note: contract auto-renews in ~11 months — target QBR readiness at month 9 to mitigate renewal risk.
jordan_pm: Action list: @sam_se -> sample payloads by COB tomorrow; @li_eng -> confirm SSO ETA; @olivia_success -> schedule enablement and create prompt/test sets. I'll own the acceptance checklist and sign-off.
olivia_success: I'll add the checklist to Confluence and collect feedback via a short 6-question survey after the demo. Plan for session: 15m demo + 15m Qs. Survey link will be posted here once ready.
maya_cs: Quick acceptance checklist (will formalize in Confluence):
```
- smoke_test: pass
- latency < 300ms
- sample_embed_match >= 0.95
- docs_shared: true
- 1st-week usage captured
```

calendar-bot: Event created: "HelioHealth 15m welcome" at 11:15. Attendees: maya_cs, jordan_pm, olivia_success, sam_se, li_eng.
sam_se: :thumbsup: I'll upload sample payloads to s3://redwood-helio/samples by 10:30 tomorrow.
li_eng: If SSO ETA slips, fallback is token-based integration for the pilot. Flagging risk: "SSO delay" (will add to tickets).
maya_cs: Great — I'll follow up with a 1-pager and set daily 10m standups for the first 5 business days to capture blockers & feedback. Thanks team :rocket:
